当叶鼎满脸绝情的说出那句断绝父子关係、逐出叶家后，叶楚尘双手握拳，呼吸加重，一张脸涨得通红，心臟更似小鹿乱撞，砰砰砰地跳个不停
他在竭力忍耐、克制和偽装著內心的狂喜。
唯恐被叶鼎和叶灵儿等人瞧出端倪，以至於离开叶家的计划落空，他叶楚尘忍得好辛苦！！
计划只成功了一小半，现在高兴还太早。
可在叶鼎和叶灵儿等人看来，听到自己要被逐出叶家，叶楚尘满脸难以置信，眼角含泪，气得一张脸通红，那绝望和心碎的样子，让她们看见了，捂著嘴偷笑。
这个贱人，现在知道怕了，活该！！
“叶楚尘，你你把我的千年火灵丹给”
叶轩依旧死死地盯著被叶楚尘踩在脚底下的，踩成一摊泥的千年火灵丹，心痛到无法呼吸。
那可是千年火灵丹啊，可遇不可求的宝贝。
只需要一粒，他叶轩便可成功破境，可如今
这个贱人真是该死，要发疯出去发去，为什么要拿自己的千年火灵丹撒气？
叶楚尘是不是被逐出叶家，叶轩一点都不关心，在他看来，这个废物即便留在叶家，自己也早晚玩死他！
“小轩，不就是千年火灵芝吗？你不用担心，咱们不吃那贱人的东西！”
五姐叶寒一看叶轩满脸心痛的样子，心都快碎了，赶忙上前安慰起来：
“我叶家可是荒古大陆上新晋的不朽世家，掌管天下九十九条灵脉，什么宝贝没有？”

“等回头姐姐就带你去家族宝库去找，一定会找到类似千年火灵芝这样的天地灵物，供你破境。”
三姐叶清清和叶灵儿也走了过来，三个女人把叶轩围了起来，你一言我一语，一边安慰叶轩，一边狠踩叶楚尘。
在几个姐姐看来，被逐出家门的叶楚尘，哪里会有痛失千年火灵丹的叶轩可怜？
“叶楚尘，你毁了小轩的千年火灵丹，这件事没完！”
“心思如此歹毒，我真是看错你了！”
“叶楚尘，父亲已经將你逐出叶家，你要是不能为小轩寻来第二株千年火灵芝，你就是把膝盖跪断了，我叶灵儿也不会让你踏进叶家的门！”
“对，让这个废物再去给小轩找一株千年火灵芝来！”
叶楚尘没有理会叶灵儿等人的狗叫，而是冷静的看向家主之位上的叶鼎，目光平静，不卑不亢。
“孽障，我已与你断绝父子关係，將你逐出叶家，你还待在我叶家作甚？”
叶鼎目光阴沉，他本以为自己说出断绝父子关係、逐出叶家这句话后，叶楚尘会像往常一样嚇得立马跪在地上，一边磕头认错，一边让自己收回成命，以彰显自己身为家主的威严。
可这小子一脸平静的看著自己，不仅没流露出一丝一毫的害怕和后悔，甚至
这让叶鼎有一种蓄满力一拳打在上的感觉，不得劲、不解气。
“依叶家祖制，凡叶家弟子有伤天害理或犯下重大过错者，需从族谱除名，逐出叶家。”
叶楚尘对家主之位上的叶鼎拱了拱手，继续开口道：
“家主只是口头上宣布將我逐出叶家，这不够”
“还请家主將我叶楚尘从族谱除名，斩断气运相连，了结因果宿命，彻彻底底的將我逐出叶家！！”
此话一出，家主之位上的叶鼎愣住了，围著叶轩的几个姐姐也惊呆了。
谁都没想到，叶楚尘会玩得这么狠。
任谁都看得出，叶鼎现在在气头上，口头上宣布断绝父子关係，將叶楚尘逐出叶家，有赌气的成分。
可一旦气头过了，又或是叶楚尘能够再为叶轩寻得一株千年火灵芝，跪在地上乞求重回叶家，那叶鼎很有可能收回这句话。
可一旦在族谱除名，那可就斩断因果和气运，从此之后叶楚尘就真真正正跟叶家一点关係都没有了。

Chapter 5 The Traveler from Blue Star (Page 1)
When Ye Ding said the sentence of severing the relationship between father and son and expelling the Ye family with a ruthless face, Ye Chuchen clenched his hands into fists, his breathing became heavier, his face turned red, and his heart was beating like a deer.
He was trying his best to endure, restrain and disguise his inner ecstasy.
Ye Chuchen was afraid that Ye Ding, Ye Ling'er and others would find out and his plan to leave the Ye family would fail. He, Ye Chuchen, had to bear it so hard! !
The plan was only half successful, and it's too early to be happy now.
But in the eyes of Ye Ding, Ye Ling'er and others, when they heard that he was going to be expelled from the Ye family, Ye Chuchen's face was full of disbelief, with tears in his eyes, and his face was red with anger. They saw his despair and heartbreak, covering his mouth and snickering.
This bitch now knows that she deserves to be scared! !
"Ye Chuchen, please give me the Millennium Fire Spirit Pill"
Ye Xuan was still staring at the Millennium Fire Spirit Pill that was trampled under Ye Chuchen's feet and turned into a puddle of mud. He was so heartbroken that he couldn't breathe.
That is the Millennium Fire Spirit Pill, a rare treasure that can only be found.
With just one pill, Ye Xuan can successfully break through the realm, but now
This bitch really deserves to die. If she wants to go crazy and take it out, why would she use her Millennium Fire Spirit Pill to take it out?
Ye Xuan doesn't care at all whether Ye Chuchen is expelled from the Ye family. In his opinion, even if this waste stays in the Ye family, he will kill him sooner or later!
"Xiaoxuan, isn't it the Millennium Fire Ganoderma? Don't worry, we won't eat that bitch's food!"
When fifth sister Ye Han saw the heartache on Ye Xuan's face, her heart almost broke, and she quickly stepped forward to comfort her:
"My Ye family is a new immortal family in the ancient continent. We are in charge of ninety-nine spiritual veins in the world. What kind of treasure do we not have?"

"When I get back, my sister will take you to the family treasure house to look for it. You will definitely find a spiritual creature from heaven and earth like the Millennium Fire Ganoderma for you to break through."
The third sister, Ye Qingqing and Ye Ling'er, also came over. The three women surrounded Ye Xuan. They comforted Ye Xuan and stepped on Ye Chuchen.
In the eyes of several sisters, how could Ye Chuchen, who was expelled from his home, be as pitiful as Ye Xuan, who had lost the Thousand Years of Fire Spirit Pill?
"Ye Chuchen, you destroyed Xiaoxuan's Millennium Fire Spirit Pill, this matter is not over yet!"
"You have such a vicious mind, I really misjudged you!"
"Ye Chuchen, my father has expelled you from the Ye family. If you can't find a second Millennium Fire Ganoderma for Xiaoxuan, even if you break your knees, I, Ye Ling'er, won't let you step into the Ye family!"
"Yes, let this loser find another Millennium Fire Ganoderma for Xiaoxuan!"
Ye Chuchen ignored the barking of Ye Ling'er and others, but calmly looked at Ye Ding, the head of the family, with calm eyes, neither humble nor overbearing.
"Nie Zhan, I have severed the father-son relationship with you and expelled you from the Ye family. Why are you still staying in my Ye family?"
Ye Ding's eyes were gloomy. He thought that after he said the words of severing the relationship between father and son and expelling the Ye family, Ye Chuchen would be so frightened that he would immediately kneel on the ground as usual, kowtow to admit his mistake, and at the same time ask himself to take back his life to show his majesty as the head of the family.
But this kid looked at him calmly. Not only did he not show any fear or regret, he even
This gave Ye Ding the feeling of punching him with all his strength, feeling weak and frustrated.
"According to the ancestral system of the Ye family, any disciple of the Ye family who has done harm to nature or committed a major mistake must be removed from the family tree and expelled from the Ye family."
Ye Chuchen bowed his hands to Ye Ding, who was the head of the family, and continued:
"The head of the family just verbally announced that I will be expelled from the Ye family. This is not enough."
"I also ask the head of the family to remove me, Ye Chuchen, from the family tree, cut off the connection of luck, end the fate of cause and effect, and drive me out of the Ye family completely!!"
As soon as these words came out, Ye Ding, the head of the family, was stunned, and the sisters surrounding Ye Xuan were also stunned.
No one thought that Ye Chuchen would play so hard.
Everyone could see that Ye Ding was so angry that he verbally announced the severance of the relationship between father and son and expelled Ye Chuchen from the Ye family, which was a sign of anger.
But once the anger is over, or if Ye Chuchen can find another Millennium Fire Ganoderma for Ye Xuan and kneel on the ground begging to return to the Ye family, then Ye Ding will most likely take back his words.
But once the name is removed from the family tree, the cause and effect and luck will be cut off. From then on, Ye Chuchen will really have no relationship with the Ye family at all.
